title: crocus vernus subsp. albiflorus
intro: Crocus vernus subsp. albiflorus, commonly known as the White Crocus, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the iris family and is native to the Balkan Peninsula. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of colds, coughs, and respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of White Crocus include its ability to reduce fever, relieve pain, and promote sweating, making it a useful remedy for treating flu and other illnesses. The bioactive constituents of White Crocus include isoquinoline alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
